name: olist_tiny_erp-mcp
display_name: Olist Tiny ERP (BR integration hub — not a supplier) MCP
description: Olist Tiny ERP (BR integration hub — not a supplier) (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_p

platform_mcp_olist_tiny_erp_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_OLIST_TINY_ERP_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_olist_tiny_erp_client_id.description: Client ID of the API v3 app created in your Olist ERP (Tiny) account (Configurações > Aplicativos; https://api-docs.erp.olist.com/).

platform_mcp_olist_tiny_erp_client_secre.title: PLATFORM_MCP_OLIST_TINY_ERP_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_olist_tiny_erp_client_secre.description: Client secret of the same app, sent in the token request body.

platform_mcp_olist_tiny_erp_refresh_toke.title: PLATFORM_MCP_OLIST_TINY_ERP_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_olist_tiny_erp_refresh_toke.description: refresh_token from the one-time authorization-code exchange (https://accounts.tiny.com.br/realms/tiny/protocol/openid-connect/auth ... then /token with grant_type=authorization_code). Access tokens expire after 4 hours and are re-minted from it; the refresh token 'tem duração de 1 dia' and each refresh returns a new one, which replaces it in memory (set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to persist it across restarts).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /info: the connected ERP company {razaoSocial, cpfCnpj, fantasia, enderecoEmpresa, fone, email, regimeTributario}.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /produtos: the products registered in YOUR Olist ERP (an ERP/integration hub, not a supplier) [{id, sku, descricao, tipo, situacao (A/I/E), unidade, gtin, precos{preco, precoPromocional, precoCusto, precoCustoMedio}}]; `query` searches the name (nome). Prices are BRL. `category` is not a filter of this endpoint.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET /produtos/{idProduto}: full product with stock (estoque.quantidade), suppliers (fornecedores[{id, nome, codigoProdutoNoFornecedor}]), category, brand, dimensions, variations and attachments in `raw`.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /ordem-compra/{idOrdemCompra}: a purchase order recorded in the ERP (ordem de compra to a supplier) {id, numeroPedido, data, dataPrevista, situacao, totalProdutos, frete, totalPedidoCompra, contato (supplier), itens[{produto, quantidade, preco}]}. Currency BRL.
